title: Buffalo Chicken Meatballs
description: From a reviewer: Simple, easy & well received! Everyone has very different tastes in my house & my boys are health conscious rowers. Wings are a thing of the past until now! I do make my own bread crumbs with leftover ends and reduce the butter~serve this with romaine lettuce (for wraps) & celery! Served as a snack, appetizer or meal, this is a hit every time! Last batch I doubled and froze uncooked! Tossed them into the oven when the crew stopped in & everyone loved them! So, so good! I always get unsolicited compliments too like ~”These are tasty mom!” These have quickly become part of my food arsenal!
ingredients: Nonstick cooking spray, for the parchment, optional
1 tablespoon hot sauce, such as Frank's Red Hot
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
5 to 6 stalks celery, cut into sticks, plus celery leaves, for serving
3/4 cup hot sauce, such as Frank's Red Hot
directions: For the meatballs: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.
Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper covered with cooking spray.
Combine the chicken, breadcrumbs, celery, hot sauce, egg, scallion, garlic and some salt and pepper in a bowl. Gently mix until well combined, being careful not to overmix.
Using a tablespoon measure, remove scoops of the mixture, roll into balls and put onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake until cooked through and browned, about 15 minutes.
For the sauce. Meanwhile, in a saute pan over medium-low heat, melt the butter with the hot sauce, stirring to combine. Once the meatballs are cooked, add to the sauce and toss to coat well.

Transfer the meatballs to a platter. Sprinkle over the gorgonzola and celery leaves. Serve with the celery stalks and leaves on the side, as well as some toothpicks to skewer the meatballs as they are devoured.
